why_this_route.supersedes: This freezes the CONCRETE recipe for the spec-authorized v2 plurigaussian route (MICROTOPOGRAPHY.md 9.10.1 v2). It replaces five failed prior bog attempts, all of which invented detail the spec forbids: v1/v5 marked-form Gaussian domes (PERMANENTLY TERMINATED by 9.10.1 after the Moore whole-form capacity artifact yielded 1 complete hollow vs a 200-form / 6-group gate) and v3/v4 anisotropic reaction-diffusion / Turing (a homogeneous Gray-Scott system selects a single wavelength; thin ridge dashes; not in the spec).
why_this_route.mechanism: Two stationary Gaussian random fields combined into one latent, ordered-thresholded to guarantee the Moore transiogram ordering, with height a SMOOTH continuous Gaussian anamorphosis of the latent (NOT per-class steps).
why_this_route.anti_invention: No FBM as the shipped surface, no marked forms, no reaction-diffusion, no per-class constant steps, no periodic lattice, no repeated stamps, no decorative noise. Height is a monotone continuous transfer of the latent percentile.

v5_marked_form_terminated.reason: the spec 9.10.1 permanently terminated the marked-form / marked-point Gaussian-dome route; it may not be resurrected

site_selection.note: the reselected pool-bearing raised bog with real ETAK Laugas pools; same site and base as the v4 pack.

sources.moore_2019_sfm: PRIMARY cm-scale surface statistics: per-class relative-height quantiles, microform size/spacing, transiograms, roughness (272 plots, 8 geographic sites, foreign temperate/boreal fens+bogs; clipped-moss SfM => amplitude LOWER bound; valid at <1-2 m lags).
sources.stordalen_2019_uav: CROSS-CHECK ONLY: amplitude bound (p95-p5 0.317 m) and roughness slope (-3.60); subarctic permafrost regime => not raised-bog class geometry.
sources.ilyasov_2026_uas_lidar: closest raised-bog analog (West Siberia): ecological area fractions (Table 2), microform bands 0.5-3 m and 10-100 m, ridge relief 0.25-0.50 m, ridges perpendicular to flow. LITERATURE numbers only.

ilyasov_to_estonian_fraction_derivation.purpose: Estonian 3-class (hollow/lawn/hummock) ecological area-fraction target from Ilyasov Table 2, recorded so it is not hand-tuned to a look.
ilyasov_to_estonian_fraction_derivation.three_class_map: hummock = RH (driest raised microform); hollow = HD (wettest lowest); lawn = RD + HH (intermediate band).
ilyasov_to_estonian_fraction_derivation.interpolation: the pool-bearing core is a ridge-hollow-patterned bog (real Laugas pools = hollows) grading toward ryam; interpolate predominantly ridge-hollow-patterned with a light ryam grade weight w = 0.25.

recipe.packer_reused: asset-gen/src/assetgen/terrain/microtopography/peat_raised_bog/network_preview.py (+ network_preview_verify.py); only the synthesis float was swapped (key core_relief_025m, 512x512, 0.25 m).
recipe.determinism: all stochastic fields draw from the shared world-PRF (BLAKE2b person laas-micro-prf1) keyed on integer world lattice coordinates; per-channel east-key offsets give independent streams; the fields are coloured by analytic spectra via circulant embedding over one FIXED work domain (core + 192 m halo) derived deterministically from the site; the storage core is cropped last; no per-chunk seeds, no seam crossfades.

coarse_field.orientation: major (long-correlation) axis perpendicular to mire downslope flow (flow angle -0.4959 rad at the core, from the 10 m DTM via peat_bog_network.hydrology)

recipe.combined_latent: L = fine + 0.8*coarse - pool_bias; standardized over authority to mean 0 std 1; ordered thresholds at the derived percentiles guarantee hollow->lawn->hummock ordering (hollow never abuts hummock).

gaussian_anamorphosis.transfer: height = amplitude * PCHIP(percentile -> relative height) of the standardized latent; monotone continuous; NOT per-class steps.
gaussian_anamorphosis.calibration: Moore pooled per-class medians (hollow ~ -0.083, lawn ~ -0.003, hummock ~ +0.089) at the derived class boundaries, scaled to the reconciled overall p95-p5 ~ 0.30 m (Stordalen 0.317, Ilyasov ridge relief 0.25-0.50 m); Moore is a clipped-moss LOWER bound.
gaussian_anamorphosis.ridge_extension: ridge_gain 0.25 lifts the positive tail toward the ridge scale in high-coarse zones.

roughness_residual.note: small high-frequency texture near the 0.25 m Nyquist; sub-microform (<0.5 m) roughness is not separately resolvable at 0.25 m and is NOT injected as decorative noise.

hydrology_pool_coupling.rule: real ETAK open water (Laugas pools + ditches) stays relief-free (exact); the latent is biased downward within the pool margin so hollows grade into pools and hummocks avoid them; relief tapers to 0 at the water boundary.

envelopes.dc_drift_guard: relief demeaned over the full-relief authority interior so the parent mean is ~unchanged; relief tapers to ~0 off-authority, at open water, and at the corrected-core boundary (corrected-region edge taper, not an inter-chunk crossfade).

measurement_notes.moore_estimators: microform gates are measured on the sigma=0.5 m detrended output, exactly Moore's method.
measurement_notes.microform_band: the radial PSD slope and dominant spacing are fit over the RESOLVABLE microform wavelength band 0.5-3 m; below 0.5 m is the detrend high-pass corner and the 0.25 m Nyquist limit (Moore's 1 cm plots resolved the sub-0.5 m roll-off; a 0.25 m surface cannot). This reproduces Moore's estimator INTENT on a coarser-sampled surface.

required_gates.ground_level_gate: the AUTHORITATIVE acceptance gate is the real-WebGPU ground-level boot of the packed preview (grass=0); top-down hillshade is NOT sufficient (it fooled the orchestrator three times).

packed_preview.note: packer/verifier (network_preview.py / network_preview_verify.py) reused unchanged; only the synthesis float was swapped.

ground_level_boot.note: real-WebGPU boot-smoke, grass=0, dry-hummock vantage; the core-center vantage sits in a pool (hollows correctly at the water table).
ground_level_boot.en_to_game: game x = E - 368640 (anchorE); game z = 6635520 (anchorN) - N
ground_level_boot.verdict: reads as a bumpy organic bog: rounded hummock-hollow microrelief AND diagonal 10-100 m ridge-hollow patterning under low raking sun; real pools; NOT dashes/lattice/blocky.

publication.runtime_role: ordinary packed height demand decode cache interpolate sample cull and render only
